answer: To resist sybils, make every agent post a refundable bond on a basalt-hard ledger before it may trade, and let its standing grow like a grove only as living peers co-sign its liveness across a full epoch. Clones minted from one funding ridge get their voting weight correlated and merged toward a single vote, and any proven duplicate forfeits its bond. Spinning up a thousand aliases then costs a thousand real stakes, so the economics - not a gatekeeper - starve the swarm.
